content: {"reasoning":"The CO-197 denial cannot be resolved through retroactive authorization or peer-to-peer review because neither is offered, and no claim-data error is identified. Although a necessity appeal was previously attempted, the published rules do not establish that appeal rights are exhausted; similar claims achieved payment through appeals in 1/5 cases versus 0/4 for clean resubmissions. A further formal necessity appeal is the best-supported available rework, while billing the entire denied balance would exceed the established contractual patient share.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
